s0
Happiness was never in the thing.
Happiness was never in the thing.
s1
Think of something you wanted badly. A phone. A person. A result.
Think of something you wanted badly. A phone. A person. A result.
s2
You got it. And for a moment, joy.
You got it. And for a moment… joy.
s3
A month later. Same phone. Same person. The joy is gone.
A month later. Same phone. Same person. The joy is gone.
s4
If the joy were inside the thing, it would still be there. The thing did not change. So where did the joy come from?
If the joy were inside the thing, it would still be there. The thing did not change. So where did the joy come from?
s5
Watch closely. Before you got it, the mind was pulling. I need that. The moment you got it, the pulling stopped.
Watch closely. Before you got it, the mind was pulling: “I need that.” The moment you got it, the pulling stopped.
s6
For one moment, nothing was missing. No wanting. Just you.
For one moment, nothing was missing. No wanting. Just you.
s7
That stillness was the joy. The object only switched off the wanting.
That stillness was the joy. The object only switched off the wanting.
s8
The {छान्दोग्य} {उपनिषद्} says, {यो वै भूमा तत् सुखम्}. The infinite alone is happiness. There is no happiness in the small.
The Chāndogya Upaniṣad says: Yo vai bhūmā tat sukham. The infinite alone is happiness. There is no happiness in the small.
s9
And the {बृहदारण्यक} goes further. Every creature lives on just a drop of this bliss.
And the Bṛhadāraṇyaka goes further: every creature lives on just a drop of this bliss.
Neuroscience notices a parallel. The brain's reward signal fades, once the prize becomes familiar.
Neuroscience notices a parallel: the brain's reward signal fades once the prize becomes familiar.
So you were never chasing the phone, or the person. You were chasing the moment the chasing stops.
So you were never chasing the phone, or the person. You were chasing the moment the chasing stops.
And what is left, when it stops, is not empty. It is you.
And what is left when it stops… is not empty. It is you.
Happiness was never in the thing. It was the one who wanted it.
Happiness was never in the thing. It was the one who wanted it.
